policy.purpose: Begin searching for recurring public Norwood events six months before the expected event date so residents have useful notice for tickets, registration, volunteering, or planning.
rules: Never wait until the prior-year event date to begin current-year discovery.
Begin discovery about 180 days before the expected event date by default.
Recheck every 30 days until 90 days before the expected event date, every 14 days from 90 through 31 days before, and every 7 days inside the final 30 days until confirmed.
For especially high-demand or unusually early-sale ticketed events, allow an even earlier first check when prior-year sale timing supports it.
Prefer the organizer or official venue as confirmation, but use secondary calendars, vendor pages, social posts and related known-event pages as discovery leads.
Once confirmed, reconcile against events.json to avoid duplicates.
